note: The order that used to ship as PREPAID. Unpaid, but the gateway is a bank transfer — neither cash-on-delivery nor blank/manual. Everything else about it is valid, so `payment_unclear` must be the only error. Guessing 'prepaid' here tells the courier to collect nothing and hand the goods over; guessing 'COD' bills a customer who may already have transferred. Neither is allowed to be a guess.
